claim_text: He tells people in Taiwan to resist rather than accept the invasion, stationing angels over the island, and says a great revival is coming out of Japan, South Korea and China with a major harvest in North Korea.
quote: if you live in Taiwan, you should be resisting this
falsify_match: No Chinese invasion of Taiwan, credited to prayer.
falsify_miss: An invasion occurs. He describes the vision as prophetic in order to be prayed against, which means an absence confirms it and an occurrence confirms it too.

claim_text: A great revival out of Japan, South Korea and China and a major harvest of souls in North Korea, with the devil resisting it because souls are what the father values.
quote: A major harvest of souls is going to take place in North Korea
falsify_match: Measurable conversion movements in all four.
falsify_miss: No measurable change. Building in that the devil will resist means slow progress is also expected.

claim_text: An exhortation that believers must take authority as Americans did in the election, with a window of three or four years given that most people will waste by putting their heads back in the sand.
quote: I'm going to give you a window
falsify_match: Not applicable; an exhortation about how to use the window.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the window length is given loosely here as three or four years.

claim_text: He says he was told he was missing it and must pray against the invasion of Taiwan and stop it, since Taiwan is a sovereign country, and that Apollyon is spinning to cause more war with Putin ahead of the Ezekiel 38 and 39 war.
quote: You must pray against the invasion of Taiwan
falsify_match: An invasion prevented in a way traceable to intercession.
falsify_miss: Not establishable either way, which is what makes the prayer framing untestable.

claim_text: The Ezekiel 38 and 39 war described as set in stone and certain to happen because the Bible says so, unlike the other things he prays against.
quote: That's set in stone. It will happen
falsify_match: The war occurring.
falsify_miss: No such war. He marks a category difference here between what prayer can change and what it cannot, which is worth recording.

claim_text: Hidden terrorist cells still in America waiting for the opportune time, and a coming event that will be a type and shadow of 9/11 that gets the whole earth's attention.
quote: a type and shadow of a 911 event
falsify_match: A mass casualty attack on American soil of comparable public effect.
falsify_miss: No such attack. Type and shadow is loose enough that a much smaller event could be claimed as fulfilment.

claim_text: He is taken back to the morning of 11 September 2001 in the vision and told that another major event is about to change everything within a 24 hour period, so that the way people live now will not last.
quote: there's another major event that's about to change everything
falsify_match: A single day that visibly changes American life.
falsify_miss: No such day. Months ahead is the only timing given and it is not tied to a year.

claim_text: Teaching against waiting for blessing to arrive by chance or lottery, in favour of sowing and praying over the seed.
quote: I don't believe in a chance. I don't believe in gambling
falsify_match: Not applicable; a giving teaching.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Multiple volcanoes coming with a mile wide one about to erupt, and instruction to watch Alaska, Canada, Japan, Italy and the oceans, with fish never seen before coming up, great pressure on the earth's crust and ash all over the United States.
quote: He said multiple volcanoes
falsify_match: Simultaneous major eruptions across the named regions with ashfall over America.
falsify_miss: Eruptions continue at the normal rate. Naming five volcanic regions covers most of the ring of fire, so some activity is guaranteed.

claim_text: A day when a major eruption goes off at Yosemite National Park, given alongside Yellowstone and Mount Fuji, with the timing unknown and possibly in the tribulation.
quote: a major eruption go off in the Yose National Park
falsify_match: A volcanic eruption at Yosemite.
falsify_miss: None occurs. Yosemite is granite batholith with no volcanic system; the Long Valley caldera is a separate site about thirty miles east, so the named park is geologically wrong.

claim_text: The new weapon that looks nuclear but is not, at Warsaw, with a fifty mile radius, so hot it melted the people while leaving the cars and buildings untouched, and he says people keep telling him what it is and he does not know.
quote: it was so hot it melted the people
falsify_match: A weapon used that kills people without damaging structures over a fifty mile radius.
falsify_miss: No such weapon exists or is used. A neutron bomb is the nearest real concept and its radius is measured in hundreds of metres, not fifty miles.

claim_text: He states that a lot of this will not be prayed away and cannot be stopped through prayer because the shaking is needed for the awakening, then describes a red dome like a membrane over Taiwan and China invading with little fight.
quote: a lot of this stuff will not be prayed away
falsify_match: An invasion of Taiwan meeting little resistance.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or a fought one. He contradicts his own instruction three days later to pray the invasion away, which is worth keeping side by side.

claim_text: China goes straight in and takes out the cabinet and the prime minister, brings in its own people and occupies Taiwan quickly, with the Taiwanese knowing they are outnumbered and not resisting.
quote: they took over the main uh cabinet and the the prime minister
falsify_match: A decapitation operation against Taiwan's leadership followed by rapid occupation.
falsify_miss: No invasion, or a long contested one. Taiwan has a president rather than a prime minister as head of state, which is a detail he gets wrong.

claim_text: He pauses to explain that in the vision China attacked while a grey substance covered the United States from New Orleans up to Canada and east, which he says he never told anyone before and prayed over instead of speaking.
quote: they attacked when that gray substance was on the land
falsify_match: Ashfall or contamination across the eastern United States coinciding with a move on Taiwan.
falsify_miss: Neither. The linkage of the two is the useful part, since it gives the Taiwan claim a precondition that would have to appear first.

claim_text: He says he could not work out whether the grey was nuclear fallout or ash, still cannot, and skipped it last time rather than speaking it, and that he prays it does not happen.
quote: I still can't figure it out
falsify_match: Grey fallout or ash over the eastern states.
falsify_miss: None. He records his own withholding here, which is the clearest example on file of a detail held back and later released.

claim_text: A hand-carved olivewood chuppah with four posts and a wooden floor, decorated with flowers, with an all-consuming fire inside it, seen alongside revival taking off in South Korea and Japan.
quote: this is out of olivewood
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; it is an emblem rather than an occurrence.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because the olivewood and the four posts recur, which lets the tellings be compared.

claim_text: A mile wide volcano under the ocean with fire coming up out of the whole circumference, then Mount Fuji going off with the whole top blown away, and another major tsunami wave hitting Seattle.
quote: I saw Mount Fuji in Japan go off
falsify_match: A Plinian eruption removing the summit of Fuji.
falsify_miss: Fuji stays quiet. The goji berry detail he attaches is not a Fuji feature, which suggests the identification is being supplied rather than seen.

claim_text: A wall of water coming inland at Seattle seen from the land by the Space Needle, with the father saying loudly not to fear because of what is coming on the earth.
quote: I saw water coming like a wall of water coming inland
falsify_match: A tsunami reaching central Seattle.
falsify_miss: No such wave. This is the earliest Seattle wave telling on file, eight days before the Space Needle height version.

claim_text: Darkness in the middle of the day and light in the middle of the day at the same time, half the sky light and half dark, which he says he cannot explain except as an eclipse and which flipped him out, alongside asteroids and comets in the sky and hundred dollar bills falling off trees.
quote: I could see half the sky was light and half the sky was dark
falsify_match: A sky-splitting darkening event witnessed widely.
falsify_miss: No such event. He offers the eclipse explanation himself and rejects it, since an eclipse does not divide the sky in half.

claim_text: Shakings on all fronts at once: the economy, politics, war, the earth and the heavens, described as a major shifting and not only about America.
quote: I saw shaking of all fronts, a major major shifting
falsify_match: Simultaneous crises across all five areas.
falsify_miss: Conditions stay within ordinary bounds in most of them. Naming five fronts means partial credit is always available.

claim_text: The grey substance described as thick grey jelly-like soot from Louisiana up to Canada and across the east, alongside revival in Texas and Oklahoma and brush harbor churches, with a window given because of the prayers of the saints in October that must not be squandered.
quote: a thick uh jelly looking uh gray soot
falsify_match: A grey deposit across the eastern half of the country.
falsify_miss: None appears. Jelly-like soot does not correspond to volcanic ash or nuclear fallout, both of which are dry.

claim_text: A major volcano going off in Hawaii, a big one, with volcanoes going off everywhere, and instruction to watch the ring of fire and Italy where there will be major earthquakes and volcanoes.
quote: Major volcano going off in Hawaii. Major
falsify_match: A major Hawaiian eruption and a significant Italian volcanic or seismic event.
falsify_miss: Ordinary Kilauea activity and ordinary Italian seismicity. This is the earliest Hawaii telling on file.

claim_text: Drilling everywhere and pipelines opened with big agreements, the Nord Stream pipeline reopened and worked on, stimulating the American economy, and great antisemitism because of anger at Israel, with Russia, Syria and Turkey wanting to retaliate.
quote: the Nordstream pipeline, I believe is what it's called
falsify_match: Nord Stream restarted under a new agreement.
falsify_miss: The pipeline stays out of service. He adds that some visions take ten years, which removes any expiry.

claim_text: He recalls giving in January that the president wanted to be diplomatic and would not push the button while Israel acted anyway, and says a black swan event is coming because they have to create a boogeyman to justify retaliation.
quote: We got to create a boogeyman
falsify_match: An incident later shown to have been manufactured to justify a response.
falsify_miss: No such demonstration. He states plainly here that he does not believe the visions have been changed by prayer, which is unusual for him.

claim_text: A recollection of saving up to buy cassette and CD teaching series at twenty five and thirty five dollars, and being unable to afford more than one at a time.
quote: which one can we have today
falsify_match: Not applicable; personal history.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He explains why he does not want to write a book or charge for teaching, saying it bothers him to charge, while acknowledging that book sales are how ministries are funded.
quote: It bothers me to want to charge for it
falsify_match: Not applicable; a statement of policy.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it is worth recording alongside the merchandise and giving material.

claim_text: A great fire and revival starting in Japan among the youth and younger generations, against great corruption, sexual perversion and very dark businessmen there.
quote: I see it even starting in Japan
falsify_match: A youth religious movement in Japan of measurable size.
falsify_miss: No such movement. Japan is under one percent Christian and has been for a century, which makes it the hardest case he names.

claim_text: A plan for China to take Taiwan seen again with battleships all around the island, and a date seen on a calendar which he does not give.
quote: I see battleships all around Taiwan
falsify_match: A Chinese naval encirclement of Taiwan.
falsify_miss: Encirclement exercises around Taiwan had already occurred repeatedly since 2022. He sees a date and does not say it, which removes the only part that would have been checkable.

claim_text: A great revival and a great humbling coming to America, with wooden platforms built of logs like a Jewish wedding canopy made of olive wood with carvings on it.
quote: I saw a great humbling coming
falsify_match: An American revival at a scale that would be recognised outside the movement.
falsify_miss: No such movement. This is the earliest olivewood canopy telling on file, two days before the fuller version.

claim_text: The carved canopy located on the Oklahoma and Texas border area, with a fire that does not consume the wood and sustains itself in the air, for the bridegroom who is getting ready for the bride.
quote: a fire that was not consuming the wood
falsify_match: A sustained revival centred on the Oklahoma Texas border.
falsify_miss: No such centre emerges. The location is where he lives, which is worth noting alongside the Tulsa and Branson material.

claim_text: He compares the canopy he saw with a picture being shown on screen, noting his had a wooden floor and was held up like a hut, and repeats that a great revival and a great shaking to awaken are coming.
quote: the one that I saw had actually wood at the floor
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because he compares his vision against an image on screen, which shows how the detail gets fixed.

claim_text: A massive volcano about a mile wide with a great explosion about to take place in the middle of it, seen in the tropics and identified as Hawaii, though he says he does not know whether Hawaii has one that big.
quote: I don't even know if they have a volcano that big in Hawaii
falsify_match: A caldera-forming eruption in Hawaii.
falsify_miss: Hawaiian eruptions stay effusive rather than explosive. He supplies the Hawaii identification himself while doubting it, which is worth recording.

claim_text: Many volcanic reactions in the days ahead as a sign, including the big snow-capped Japanese mountain where the goji berries are, coming alive, and volcanoes into Alaska all along the seaboard on the ring of fire.
quote: I see the volcano coming alive
falsify_match: Fuji becoming active.
falsify_miss: Fuji stays quiet. This is the earliest Fuji telling on file; goji berries are grown in China rather than on Fuji, so the identifying detail is imported.

claim_text: Hundred dollar bills falling off a massive oak tree like leaves and turning into digital currency before they hit the ground, with a great financial shaking still to come and a window given because intercession pushed things back.
quote: they turn into digital before they hit the ground
falsify_match: Physical cash replaced by a digital dollar during a financial crisis.
falsify_miss: Cash remains. The image is unusually precise about the mechanism: money arrives and is converted before it can be held.

claim_text: Some of the biggest tsunamis and biggest earthquakes the world has ever known are about to take place, repeated for emphasis, with great pressure on the earth's crust at the ring of fire and Italy named.
quote: the biggest earthquakes this world has ever known
falsify_match: An earthquake exceeding magnitude 9.5 or a tsunami exceeding the 2004 and 2011 events.
falsify_miss: Nothing exceeds the record. This is the earliest telling of the record-breaking claim on file, and it has a hard benchmark.

claim_text: Every major catastrophic event he has ever seen shown again at once on time stamps like a movie screen, which he says was so heavy he went quiet; then Trump Media selling shares to fifty companies and raising two and a half billion dollars to buy Bitcoin at an all-time high.
quote: he raised up $2.5 billion to buy Bitcoin at an all-time high
falsify_match: Not a prediction: the raise was announced on 27 May 2025, four days before this.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. Recorded because he treats a reported corporate action as material for the vision rather than as news.

claim_text: A baby holding the Star of David flag and a bald eagle over the centre of the flag near the Washington monument, faded and transparent like a hologram, with decisions to be made.
quote: there is a baby with the Star of David flag
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event; an emblem of the American and Israeli relationship.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The transparency of the eagle is the detail he treats as meaningful.

claim_text: A birthing of America and a new dawning for the window, seen as two babies, one with Israel and one with America, with fireworks above the eagle at night.
quote: a baby with Israel, a baby with America, a birthing
falsify_match: A formal new agreement between the two states read as a birth.
falsify_miss: Not checkable as stated. The fireworks at night recur with his Fourth of July material.

claim_text: A baby wrapped in a red white and blue flag, with the vision stalling as it did with the dam that did not flow before it broke, and instruction to pray it into being.
quote: a baby wrapped up in a a red, white, and blue flag
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. He describes the vision stalling and needing prayer to continue, which is how the sessions handle a gap.

claim_text: Tennessee and Georgia seen with African Americans, and roots of hurt from a painful history being uprooted and washed rather than ignored, which he is told is restitution.
quote: The Lord says it's restitution
falsify_match: An identifiable act of restitution or reconciliation at national scale.
falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind. Restitution is used here in a racial reconciliation sense rather than the financial sense it carries elsewhere in the corpus.

claim_text: A historical montage: the Civil War and its troops, Abraham Lincoln, Benjamin Franklin's vision extended to New York, the Empire State Building going up, a rocking gypsy cart, and the Golden Gate Bridge being painted red.
quote: it's an extension to Benjamin Franklin's vision going to New York
falsify_match: Not applicable; all of it is past.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. The gypsy cart is the one element he cannot place, which he says himself.

claim_text: The montage continues to the present with people singing from sea to sea, and the founding history said to lead to where America is now.
quote: And it all comes to where we are right now
falsify_match: Not applicable; a historical narrative.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: A new birthing of the glory and one more visitation to America, with a new industrial revolution, a golden age and a golden window, and when he asks how long the window lasts he is told not to worry about it.
quote: A new industrial revolution, a golden age, a golden window
falsify_match: A technological and economic boom of the scale the phrase implies.
falsify_miss: No such boom. He asks for the window length and is told not to worry about it, which is the clearest instance on file of a timing question being refused.

claim_text: Putin becoming demonically energised and influencing Syria, Russia and Israel, holding five cards like a poker face, with North Korea joining him further, and he says he has heard things behind closed doors that nobody else knows, comparing himself to a prophet in the enemy's councils while calling himself a watchman rather than a prophet.
quote: I'm not calling myself a prophet, but I'm a watchman
falsify_match: Disclosed Russian and North Korean plans matching what he says he heard.
falsify_miss: Nothing disclosed. He declines the prophet title while claiming the function, which is his standard position.

claim_text: Putin striking Poland near Warsaw with a weapon never used before, which vaporises and disintegrates the people over a fifty mile radius while leaving cars and houses untouched, with news headlines saying nothing like it has been seen.
quote: it disintegrated. It it vaporized everybody
falsify_match: A Russian strike on Poland with a weapon that kills without damaging structures.
falsify_miss: No such strike. This is the earliest Warsaw weapon telling on file, twelve days before the mushroom cloud version, and it is the more specific of the two.
